#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Surface energy calculation for Aluminum [0,0,1]

# Energies from LAMMPS simulations
E_bulk = -1679.86275358002  # eV
E_surface = -1631.81097249017  # eV

# Box dimensions after 5x5x5 replication
Lx = 20.19465  # Angstroms
Ly = 20.19465  # Angstroms

# Calculate cross-sectional area (x-y plane for [0,0,1] surface)
A = Lx * Ly  # Ų

print(f"Bulk energy: {E_bulk} eV")
print(f"Surface energy: {E_surface} eV")
print(f"Energy difference: {E_surface - E_bulk} eV")
print(f"Cross-sectional area: {A} Ų")

# Calculate surface energy per unit area
# Factor of 2 accounts for two surfaces (top and bottom)
gamma = (E_surface - E_bulk) / (2 * A)

print(f"\nSurface energy: {gamma} eV/Ų")
print(f"Surface energy (formatted): {gamma:.2f}")
